# MasterTools - Free Online Calculators & Developer Utilities

> High-performance, privacy-first web utility suite providing free online calculators, academic converters, developer tools, and productivity utilities.

MasterTools provides free client-side tools designed for students, developers, and professionals. All calculations execute 100% within the browser with zero backend logging or data collection.

## Featured Utilities

- [CGPA Calculator](https://masterperi5.me/tools/cgpa-calculator): Calculate cumulative grade point average (CGPA) based on course credits and 10-point college scales.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://masterperi5.me/tools/percentage-calculator): Calculate exam percentages, total mark ratios, and grade classifications.
- [Attendance Calculator](https://masterperi5.me/tools/attendance-calculator): Track lecture attendance and calculate classes needed or allowed to miss to meet cutoffs (e.g. 75% or 80%).
- [Age Calculator](https://masterperi5.me/tools/age-calculator): Compute chronological age in years, months, days, total days lived, and next birthday countdown.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://masterperi5.me/tools/json-formatter): Client-side JSON beautifier, minifier, validator, and instant syntax error detection tool.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://masterperi5.me/tools/word-counter): Real-time word, character, sentence, paragraph, and reading time analyzer.
